whyItMatters: gets() reads input with no length limit, so any overlong line overflows the destination buffer. The function cannot be used safely and was removed from the C standard.
actions: Replace gets() with fgets(buf, sizeof buf, stdin) and strip the trailing newline.
Use getline() where input length is unbounded and handle allocation failure.
Re-run a SAST scan after the fix and confirm DPK-SAST-011 is no longer observed.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and no gets( call remains in the changed files.
